note.en: Verified 2026-09-29 against the NZQA University Entrance page. All four parts are required; missing any one means no UE. Universities and individual programmes set additional rank-score and subject requirements on top of UE - always link to their own pages.
note.zh: 2026-09-29 对照 NZQA University Entrance 页面核实。四项缺一不可。各大学与各专业在 UE 之上另有 rank score 与指定科目要求，一律链接其官网。

rule.en: 14 credits at Level 3 in each of 3 approved subjects.
rule.zh: 三门 UE 认可科目，每门在 Level 3 各取得 14 学分。

rule.en: 10 literacy credits at Level 2 or above: 5 in reading and 5 in writing.
rule.zh: Level 2 或以上的 10 个读写学分：阅读 5 + 写作 5。

rule.en: 10 numeracy credits at Level 1 or above.
rule.zh: Level 1 或以上的 10 个算术学分。
